[[File:Opit-Wenbruh_the_Tren.jpg|thumb|upright|right|[[Opit-Wenbruh]] a Tren resistance sympathizer]]
The '''Tren resistance''' was composed of several groups of [[Tren]] opposed to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As the Tren's three colony [[Planet/Legends|planets]] voted one by one to join the Galactic Empire, their governments opposed the resistance groups and wiped many of them out. When the third and final colony, [[Nopsin]], voted to join the Empire, the resistance groups gave up trying to agitate for the Tren to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

The Tren [[Opit-Wenbruh]] sympathized with the Tren resistance on Nopsin, but he never joined due to the sense of duty he felt toward the Nopsin military, of which he was a member.
